descriptionChirho: To corrupt, defile, or cause moral deterioration, whether of minds led astray from purity (2 Cor 11:3), morals ruined by bad company (1 Cor 15:33), the old self decaying through deceitful desires (Eph 4:22), or the great prostitute corrupting the earth (Rev 19:2, 2 Cor 7:2).
To destroy or bring to physical ruin as an act of judgment, such as God destroying those who defile his temple (1 Cor 3:17), the wicked perishing like irrational animals (2 Pet 2:12, Jude 10).
